source.title: Making Gold With Enchanting - Disenchanting with Auctioneer
source.author: BeyondTheNumbers2011

quote: 2 Greater Celestial Essences; Greater Eternal Essence; 5 Illusion Dust
notes: Original author lists purchases of Gallant Flamberge of the Tiger (one weapon), Bladefist Dagger of the Beast (one weapon), and Mighty Gauntlets of the Monkey (two armor pieces), followed by ONE combined list of enchanting materials received. The author does not attribute an output to an individual item, show four separate DE events or identify exact suffix IDs/levels, so inputItemID and casts stay null. The four listed purchases are not proof of four separately recorded casts. Unreported outputs are not zeros; skill, enchantment, version, histograms and modern Retail applicability remain unknown. No gold prices retained.
inputName: Mixed Gallant Flamberge, Bladefist Dagger and two Mighty Gauntlets
